literal_meaning: নিজের কোলে জাল টানা (pulling the net into one's own lap)
figurative_meaning_en: To prioritize one's own interests first
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে আপন কোলে ঝোল টানা করে শুধু নিজের লাভের কথা ভাবল।
কাজের সময় সবাই আপন কোলে ঝোল টানা করে চলে।
example_sentences_in_english: He pulled the net in his own lap by only thinking about his own benefit.
In tough times, everyone tends to pull the net in their own lap.
note: The idiom draws from rural imagery of fishing or netting, emphasizing self-preservation in Bengali folk wisdom.
